summary: leakdeep 2.6.2: traced content triggered output-safety filtering with no corroborating static evidence
details: The package leakdeep version 2.6.2 on PyPI could not be fully characterized from its shipped contents. No a static rule matches were produced against the 20 files scanned, and no concrete behavioral evidence (install-time network I/O, credential path reads, subprocess execution of fetched content, lifecycle hooks) was captured for this record. During tracing, the content of the package caused the model's output-safety filter to withhold the trace, which is an atypical outcome for benign libraries and warrants caution, but on its own it does not identify a specific installer-harm mechanism (no named exfiltration destination, no named credential read, no named execution sink).

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
